skills.name: SQLMap target prep: Normalize a target URL
skills.description: Prepare a canonical endpoint that the app’s HTTP(S) validator accepts.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Normalize the exact HTTP(S) endpoint and identify candidate inputs from approved documentation or a normal request.
2. Preserve a baseline and note redirects, dynamic values, and expected status codes.
3. Include scheme, host, approved path, and real query string; remove fragments/whitespace while preserving meaningful values.
4. Pass the full approved URL to `web.sqlmap`; use `parameter` to narrow to one named input.

Safety: test only explicitly authorized targets. Keep defaults; do not enumerate or dump records, use shells/file access, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
